notes: The accepted alignment gave would have to ἄν and only they … had to εἶχον. Rule 50's own precedent, σὺ ἂν ᾔτησας αὐτόν → thou wouldest have asked him, gives the bare modal to the particle and the perfect auxiliary to the verb, so have moves into εἶχον's unit.
εἶχον's unit is discontinuous under rule 15, the ἄν-licensed would standing between they and have had.
